fieldValues.title: Decisions are scattered over many stores and some are lost in branches
fieldValues.statement: Our decisions live in at least seven stores and in PR text and branches, with no index between them. I cannot tell where a decision is recorded or how it got there, cite it reliably, or be sure it was not lost with a branch.
source_ref: Finding: decisions are recorded in at least seven stores with no shared index (2026-10-28)
